verdict.rationale: Veriff documents manual review of verification sessions in its Customer Portal, where sessions are opened on the Verifications page and decisions can be made there (veriff-docs-12, -13, -26, -46). Reviewer actions feed back through a user-defined statuses webhook that fires when a user adds a status to an attempt (veriff-docs-48). Session details can also be exported to PDF (veriff-docs-14). Missing for 10: evidence that borderline sessions are automatically routed into a review queue, explicit documentation that reviewers see document images, extracted fields and check results side by side, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
